messages:
lina-support: FYI Helix Analytics opened a ticket — their Azure Marketplace invoice for billing period ending 2026-03-01 shows line item 'AZ-SKU-LQ' = 2,450 units but our usage dashboard shows 1,650 tokens. They say their workload was low that day. Can billing ops triage? /cc @omar-billing
omar-billing: can you attach the invoice PDF and the tenant id? also need a sample of the marketplace raw export if they have it
lina-support: pasted the invoice excerpt they sent (redacted):
```
Invoice: 2026-03-AZ-00987
Line: AZ-SKU-LQ | 2,450 | USD | 2026-03-01
Tenant: helix-prod (tenant_id: helix-441)
```
marketplace-bot: Marketplace ingestion run completed: marketplace-import/azure/2026-03-02T08:05:12Z — rows: 6,120 — tenants: 612 — anomalies: 12
kris-ops: pulled raw rows for tenant helix-441 spanning 2026-02-28..2026-03-02. sample export:
```
2026-02-28T23:55:42-07:00,helix-prod,sku=AZ-LQ,units=900
2026-03-01T00:00:10+00:00,helix-prod,sku=AZ-LQ-LEG,units=1200
2026-03-01T00:00:45+00:00,helix-prod,sku=AZ-LQ,units=350
```
lina-support: note: some rows in raw feed are PST timestamps (-07:00) and some are UTC. invoice uses UTC day boundaries, our dashboard normalizes to customer local tz by tenant which can split bucket boundaries.
omar-billing: preliminary counts: raw_sum_units=2450, post_processed_units=2420, dashboard_tokens=1650. Looks like two root causes: 1) SKU aliasing (AZ-LQ vs AZ-LQ-LEG) created near-duplicate meter events, and 2) our dashboard applies a 120s dedupe window and timezone normalization by tenant local tz, whereas marketplace invoice is strict UTC. That produces mismatched aggregates.
kris-ops: I checked the sku_map table — AZ-SKU-LQ invoice id maps to internal sku AZ-LQ and also still maps to legacy id AZ-LQ-LEG via a compatibility rule. The legacy rule was left as a fallback during a 2024 migration and can generate duplicate effective rows at ingest.
lina-support: customer asked for a clear timeline and remediation ETA they can use for their finance team. what's the plan and how long will reconciliation take?
omar-billing: proposed plan:
- short term: open a dispute with Azure attaching our reconciled counts and request invoice correction. need invoice PDF + merchant id from customer. mark invoice as disputed in our billing tracker.
- medium term: change ingest mapping to collapse alias targets at ingest time (compute event_hash across raw fields and dedupe across mapped aliases). then re-run postprocess for helix-441 for 2026-02-28..2026-03-02 and publish corrected reconciliation to customer.
- long term: standardize on marketplace UTC billing_timestamp for day cutoffs in all export/analytics pipelines, add unit tests and a monitoring alert for tenant-level invoice vs dashboard deltas > 10%
kris-ops: repro/backfill steps I used locally (can run on prod after sign-off):
1) export raw: `SELECT * FROM marketplace_raw WHERE tenant_id='helix-441' AND event_time >= '2026-02-28' AND event_time < '2026-03-03';`
2) checkout branch `fix/azure-sku-dedupe` and run `scripts/postprocess_marketplace --tenant helix-441 --start 2026-02-28 --end 2026-03-03 --tz=UTC`
3) compare `postprocessed_units` to invoice units and generate CSV diff.
I estimate the backfill for this tenant (3-day window) ~ 2 minutes runtime + 30 minutes for manual verification and packaging.
lina-support: I'll ask Helix for the invoice PDF and merchant billing id now and confirm whether they changed subscriptions or regions around midnight UTC. will CC you, Omar.
tess-legal: note: retention/compliance — we must store original raw import files and any backfill outputs in the audit bucket for legal review. Please upload to `s3://redwood-marketplace-audit/2026/helix-441/` and include a checksum manifest.
omar-billing: thanks — once we have the invoice PDF I'll open the Azure dispute portal and attach our reconciled CSV and the planned ingest fix. If duplicate mapping is root cause we should proactively scan other tenants for the legacy alias and publish a short customer bulletin.
lina-support: thanks team. marking this high priority. I'll update thread once Helix replies with docs. :eyes:
